patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography dominates sections, often extending edge-to-edge, creating an immersive visual experience.
Asymmetrical, editorial grid layouts are used for image galleries and content blocks, breaking from typical uniform grids to create visual interest.
Large, airy serif headings with generous letter spacing are paired with small, understated sans-serif body text, creating a sophisticated contrast and ample white space.
A muted, natural color palette derived from skin tones and natural light photography, with off-white backgrounds and dark brown text, evokes a sense of calm and luxury.
Sections and individual image elements reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport during scrolling.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background video that plays on load. Upon initial scroll, the video transitions to a static image or a paused frame, which then scrolls up to reveal the subsequent content.

Content sections and individual visual elements are introduced with a scroll-triggered animation, typically a subtle fade-in combined with a slight upward translation, as they become visible in the viewport.
The primary navigation is integrated directly into the hero video/image and is not sticky; it scrolls out of view with the hero, maintaining a clean, minimal aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, airy serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous letter spacing are contrasted with small, understated sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp, consistently applied to all image and container corners.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy in hero and between major sections, with balanced density within content blocks.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its dominant use of full-bleed, high-quality, artistic photography of skin and faces, seamlessly integrated with minimal text and an airy layout. The editorial-style image grids and subtle scroll-triggered reveals prioritize visual storytelling and a luxurious feel over dense information, making the aesthetic itself a key part of the brand message.
